result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is truncated/clipped mid-word without an ellipsis, making it appear broken rather than intentionally shortened.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and appropriate max-width so truncated text ends with '...' instead of cutting off mid-word, giving users a clear visual cue that the name continues.
